line: Someone senior likes your work today. Take the feedback and the credit.
A picky request lands today. Do it properly once, then let it go.
Good day to compare prices before you tap. The other shop might be cheaper.
An unexpected yes comes your way today. Act on it before lunch ends.
You'll want to rewrite someone's email today. Suggest edits; don't take over.
Treat yourself today: nice stationery or a good kaya toast. Small joy, big lift.
A colleague wants the same project today. Talk it out; there's room for two.
Your kind of people are on form today. Plan something together; keep the chat short.
Someone has a useful tip today. Ask, listen, then make it your own.
Things click quietly today. Write down the idea before the next notification.
